verdict.rationale: Check documents a payroll lifecycle of creating, previewing and approving a payroll object, and offers an embeddable Component to run payroll. That covers the preview-and-submit core of the story. The evidence does not show a single ops-facing flow that explicitly includes reviewing hours and earnings. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of reviewing hours/earnings within the run flow, detail on the Run Payroll Component's end-to-end steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run a full payroll cycle end-to-end — review hours and earnings, preview totals, and submit — in one flow

citations.quote: This documentation guides you through the steps required to create, preview, approve, and delete a payroll object.
